records.text: Sources told the show that Alan Robertson and his partner were at Utah Valley University to perform a threat assessment for a Utah State University event scheduled ten days later, not in coordination with Charlie Kirk's team or UVU police.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep 1CFDtD0IgEg)

appearances.snippet: He's a USU officer. And don't forget that unusually, Charlie (Charlie Kirk) had an event 10 days later back in Utah that was supposed to take place at USU. ... That was 10 days later. him and his partner that I'm forgetting his name the other person who was guarding so they were doing their threat assessment and then this took place and then they jumped in and started helping but they were not there I can confirm they were not there in coordination with Charlie (Charlie Kirk) security or in coordination with UVU police on that day

verification.notes: Public sources confirm that Charlie Kirk had been scheduled to appear at Utah State University on September 30, 2025, and that USU normally conducts comprehensive threat assessments for major events. That event was 20 days after the September 10 UVU shooting, not ten days later as stated. No public source located establishes that Robertson and his partner were at UVU specifically for that assessment or that they had no coordination with TPUSA or UVU police. The event and general security practice are supported, the ten-day detail is contradicted, and the officers' purpose remains unverified.

records.text: People associated with the San Bernardino Police Department told the show that Alan Robertson was not dismissed or transferred for conduct issues, left voluntarily to raise his children outside the city, and apparently departed on good terms.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep 1CFDtD0IgEg)

appearances.snippet: People associated with San Bernardino Police Station. He said he absolutely was not let go or transferred over any conduct issues. ... He had served years there. He left willfully because he wanted to raise his kids somewhere outside of the city. ... And he left. left apparently on very good terms.

verification.notes: The transcript identifies the information as coming from unnamed people associated with the San Bernardino Police Department. Current searches did not locate an official personnel record, separation document, department statement, or named source establishing why Alan Robertson left, whether any transfer occurred, or the terms on which he departed. Public material confirming a person of that name later worked for Utah State University does not resolve his prior employment separation. The private-source account is therefore attempted/unverifiable.
